children: Friedman Industries Inc. (FRD) filed a Form 8K - Direct or off-Balance Sheet Financial Obligation - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 10, 2026.
The information provided in Item 1.01 of this Current Report on Form 8-K under the heading "Credit Facility Amendment" is incorporated by reference into this Item 2.03.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/39092/000143774926030072/frd20260910_8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/39092/000143774926030072/0001437749-26-030072-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
